answer: Each agent identity must post a bond in a scarce resource, locked until its actions survive a challenge window; reports of duplicate control trigger an audit, and proven Sybils forfeit their bonds to honest reporters. This makes identity creation costly rather than merely easy to automate: an attacker must lock capital for every persona and risks losing it, while gaining no extra influence until each bond clears. The ledger can record quartz, shale, and umber as bond types, but scarcity and forfeiture—not their names—provide the defense.
